$comment: Shared operator/runtime contract for the zone identity token (ADR-0004 Amendment 1 Decisions 8 to 11). The operator renders the zone half (signing-key mount and issuer env on the zone's Knative Service) and the function half (JWKS mount and verifier env on the function's Knative Service) from these values; the zone signer and the function verifiers read the same paths and names. Asserted by the operator's Go test (zone_signing_key_test.go, TestSharedZoneIdentityFixture). Changing one side alone reds the other's test.
